# Shipday Studio

> Remote, fixed-price design studio for businesses, creators and brands worldwide, in any industry. Landing pages ($390, live in 48h), YouTube thumbnails (4 for $79 total, or 1 for $20, 24h; Creator Lite plan of 4 a month for $79/month; Creator plan of 12 a month for $179/month), logo packs (3 concepts for $149, 48h), a Channel Launch Kit (logo, banner, profile picture and 4 thumbnails for $199, 48h) and website upkeep ($49/month). Prices in USD, paid up front through Stripe checkout. No calls, no quotes, no hourly billing.

How ordering works: pick a package and pay through Stripe, then email a short brief to hello@shipdaystudio.com. Each one-off package includes 1 revision round. Production is AI-assisted, and every deliverable is quality-checked before delivery, with revisions included. Every sample on the site is a concept for a fictional brand, not a client project.

Contact: hello@shipdaystudio.com · X: https://x.com/ShipdayStudio
